original.name: star_rmatch_iff
original.statement: RegularExpression α) : ∀ x : List α, (star P).rmatch x ↔ ∃ S : List (List α), x = S.flatten ∧ ∀ t ∈ S, t ≠ [] ∧ P.rmatch t

have_tree.name: IH
have_tree.body: fun t (_h : List.length t < List.length x) => star_rmatch_iff P t
